task: Repair the current main Plan Before Code quality gate so critical proof-only transactions whose projected files are exclusively neutral/test or knowledge-infrastructure paths may truthfully use empty domain/authority projections while architecture-bearing projected files remain fail-closed.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live Sentinel plan-isolation repair exposed an unsatisfiable current-main Plan Before Code invariant: a critical transaction that projects only a neutral test file correctly resolves projectedDomains=[] and projectedAuthorities=[], yet the gate unconditionally requires both declarations to be non-empty. Historical draft PR #798 already demonstrated and implemented the intended invariant on an older base, but it never reached main. The current main must port only that bounded logic and regression proof without weakening exact domain/authority drift checks for architecture-bearing projected files.
observableOutcomes: Critical neutral/test-only or knowledge-infrastructure-only projected scopes may declare empty expectedDomains/expectedAuthorities when the canonical architecture projection is empty.
Any projected architecture-bearing file still requires non-empty expectedDomains/expectedAuthorities.
Exact projected domain and authority drift comparisons remain unconditional and fail closed.
The Plan Gate exposes a deterministic architecture-scope self-test covering neutral-only, knowledge-infrastructure-only, product-code and mixed projections.
The blocked Sentinel plan-isolation branch can subsequently pass Plan Before Code without false metadata.
unresolvedRisks: A broad exemption could let product-code plans omit ownership.
Neutral classification drift could accidentally suppress required architecture scope.
Knowledge-infrastructure paths must remain separately classified from product-code paths.
Porting the old #798 implementation blindly could overwrite newer current-main Plan Gate logic.

in: Port only the neutral architecture-scope prerequisite logic from historical #798 into current main.
Add/retain the architecture-scope self-test in shoperation-plan-before-code.mjs.
Preserve current-main release decomposition, implementation skeleton, exact-head transaction identity and gate-chain logic.
out: No broad exemption from domain/authority drift checks.
No changes to Sentinel evaluator semantics.
No changes to storefront, Builder, database, authentication, payments or deployment behavior.
No merge or retarget of the old #798 branch itself.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This change alters a canonical planning prerequisite. A false exemption could permit unowned product changes, while the current bug blocks truthful neutral proof-only repairs. Exact boundary behavior must therefore be proven adversarially.

acceptanceCriteria: Plan Before Code conditionally requires non-empty expectedDomains/expectedAuthorities only when at least one projected file is architecture-bearing.
Product-code and mixed projections return architectureScopeRequired=true.
Exact projectedDomains/expectedDomains and projectedAuthorities/expectedAuthorities comparisons remain unchanged and unconditional.
Regression tests prove both truthful neutral scope and product-code fail-closed behavior.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
invariants: Architecture-bearing projected files may never pass with empty expectedDomains or expectedAuthorities.
Neutral/test-only proof scope may not be forced to invent false ownership metadata.
Knowledge-infrastructure-only scope may remain ownership-neutral when the Atlas projection is empty.
Domain and authority drift detection remains exact.
Current main logic outside the targeted prerequisite remains unchanged.

failureModes: Neutral projected scope remains unsatisfiable because non-empty ownership is still unconditional.
Architecture-bearing product scope is accidentally exempted.
Knowledge-infrastructure classification diverges from unresolved-scope semantics.
Regression self-test does not exercise mixed architecture-bearing scope.
Port collides with newer current-main planner logic.
edgeCases: A neutral test and product runtime file are projected together.
Projected domains are empty while expected declarations are falsely non-empty.
Projected domains are non-empty while expected declarations are empty.
Expected declarations differ from non-empty projected ownership.
A future neutral-pattern policy change reclassifies the test path.

alternatives.summary: Require non-empty ownership declarations only when projected files include architecture-bearing scope.
alternatives.reason: Matches truthful Atlas output while preserving exact drift enforcement.
Would make plan metadata intentionally false.

alternatives.summary: Touch a product or architecture file solely to satisfy the prerequisite.
alternatives.reason: Would widen material scope and invalidate proof-only intent.

alternatives.summary: Skip domain/authority checks for critical plans.
alternatives.reason: Would weaken Control Plane authority guarantees.

specialistReviews.finding: Empty ownership cannot become a general critical-plan bypass.
specialistReviews.resolution: Gate only the non-empty prerequisite on architecture-bearing projected files while retaining exact drift comparison for every plan.

specialistReviews.finding: The contradiction is deterministic when canonical projected ownership is empty but the declaration prerequisite is unconditional.
specialistReviews.resolution: Reuse the same neutral and knowledge-infrastructure classification already trusted by unresolved-scope logic.

specialistReviews.finding: The live Sentinel repair reproduced the old #798 prerequisite gap on current main.
specialistReviews.resolution: Port the already-proven invariant as a bounded current-main fix and keep the historical branch untouched.

specialistReviews.finding: The gate fix is a prerequisite and must not be mixed with the downstream Sentinel test-isolation material change.
specialistReviews.resolution: Merge this Control Plane repair first, then rebase/reproject the Sentinel repair from fresh main.

challenge.scenario: Critical plan projects only a neutral test file.
challenge.finding: Canonical domains/authorities are empty; unconditional non-empty prerequisite is unsatisfiable.
challenge.resolution: architectureScopeRequired=false; allow empty declarations but still compare exact arrays.

challenge.scenario: Critical plan projects only a knowledge-infrastructure planner script.
challenge.finding: Ownership may be empty by the same scope policy used by unresolved-scope logic.
challenge.resolution: Treat knowledge-infrastructure as non-architecture-bearing for the prerequisite.

challenge.scenario: Critical plan projects product runtime code.
challenge.resolution: architectureScopeRequired=true and non-empty declarations remain mandatory.

challenge.scenario: Projection mixes neutral test and product code.
challenge.finding: Neutral content must not suppress product ownership.
challenge.resolution: Use files.some(isArchitectureBearingProjectedFile), so any product file requires ownership.

challenge.scenario: Expected ownership is non-empty but canonical projected ownership is empty.
challenge.resolution: Keep exact DOMAIN_SCOPE_DRIFT and AUTHORITY_SCOPE_DRIFT comparisons unconditional.

challenge.scenario: Expected ownership is empty but canonical product ownership is non-empty.
challenge.finding: A conditional prerequisite alone is insufficient.
challenge.resolution: Exact drift comparison still blocks the mismatch.

challenge.finding: Hard-coded filename exceptions would silently rot.
challenge.resolution: Reuse isNeutralFile and scopePolicy.knowledgeInfrastructurePrefixes rather than hard-coded current paths.

challenge.scenario: Historical #798 code is applied wholesale to current main.
challenge.finding: Newer planner logic could be lost.
challenge.resolution: Port only helper/self-test/conditional prerequisite lines plus regression assertions.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require current-main Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Port the minimal #798 neutral-scope helper and conditional prerequisite into current scripts/shoperation-plan-before-code.mjs.
Add the historical regression assertion pattern to current tests/shoperation-change-impact-atlas.test.ts without overwriting newer tests.
Require exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental Replay/Release Risk/full tests/typecheck/build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle PASS.
Merge only after exact PR-head proof, then resume the Sentinel plan-isolation repair from fresh main.

requirements.requirement: Critical proof-only plans with exclusively neutral or knowledge-infrastructure projections can truthfully use empty domain/authority declarations without bypassing exact scope drift checks.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Architecture-bearing critical plans cannot pass with empty expectedDomains/expectedAuthorities.

notes: Current-main port of the bounded invariant previously proven on historical draft PR #798. Live need reproduced by Sentinel plan-isolation CI #9056: projected neutral test scope has canonical projectedDomains=[] and projectedAuthorities=[], but current main unconditionally emits DEV_PLAN_EXPECTED_DOMAINS_REQUIRED and DEV_PLAN_EXPECTED_AUTHORITIES_REQUIRED. This prerequisite fix remains separate from the downstream Sentinel test-isolation implementation.
